def.en: A belief that many people repeat as true even though evidence shows it is false or only partly true.
def.hg: Aisi belief jisse bahut log sach maankar repeat karte hain, jabki evidence batata hai ki woh galat hai ya sirf partly sahi hai.

def.en: A topic that a society avoids talking about openly, such as periods, which allows wrong ideas about it to spread unchecked.
def.hg: Aisa topic jis pe society openly baat karne se bachti hai, jaise periods, aur isi wajah se uske baare mein galat baatein bina rok-tok phailti rehti hain.

def.en: Unfair shame or negative judgement attached to a person because of a body process, a health condition or who they are.
def.hg: Kisi insaan pe uski body ke kisi process, health condition ya uski identity ki wajah se thopi gayi unfair sharam ya negative judgement.

def.en: The monthly shedding of the lining of the uterus through the vagina as blood and tissue; also called a period.
def.hg: Har mahine uterus ki lining ka blood aur tissue ke roop mein vagina ke raaste bahar aana; isse period bhi bolte hain.

def.en: The release of semen from the penis during sleep. It is a normal, uncontrollable part of puberty and not a sign of illness.
def.hg: Neend ke dauraan penis se semen ka nikalna. Yeh puberty ka normal part hai jisse control nahi kiya ja sakta, aur yeh bimari ka sign nahi hai.

def.en: The years when a child's body gradually changes into an adult body, driven by hormones. It starts at different ages for different people.
def.hg: Woh saal jab hormones ki wajah se bachche ki body dheere-dheere adult body mein badalti hai. Yeh alag-alag logon mein alag-alag age pe start hoti hai.

def.en: A thin, stretchy rim of tissue at the opening of the vagina. It varies naturally and cannot show whether someone has had sex.
def.hg: Vagina ke opening pe tissue ka ek patla, stretchy rim. Yeh naturally har kisi mein alag hota hai aur yeh nahi dikha sakta ki kisi ne sex kiya hai ya nahi.

def.en: Any examination claiming to show whether a person has had sex. It is unscientific and condemned by WHO, and the two-finger test is prohibited by India's Supreme Court.
def.hg: Aisa koi bhi examination jo yeh dikhane ka claim kare ki kisi ne sex kiya hai ya nahi. Yeh unscientific hai aur WHO ne isse condemn kiya hai, aur two-finger test ko India ke Supreme Court ne prohibit kiya hai.

def.en: A recognised, culture-linked worry about losing semen, often with tiredness and guilt. It is not a physical disease and improves with a doctor's help.
def.hg: Semen loss ko lekar culture se judi ek recognised worry, jiske saath aksar thakaan aur guilt hota hai. Yeh physical bimari nahi hai aur doctor ki help se isme improvement aata hai.

def.en: Having an infection without any signs or symptoms. Many STIs are asymptomatic, which is why only testing can confirm them.
def.hg: Infection hona par uska koi sign ya symptom na hona. Bahut se STIs asymptomatic hote hain, isiliye sirf testing se unka pata chalta hai.

def.en: A method used within 5 days after unprotected sex to prevent pregnancy, mainly by delaying ovulation. It does not end an established pregnancy.
def.hg: Unprotected sex ke baad 5 din ke andar pregnancy rokne ke liye use hone wala method, jo mainly ovulation ko delay karta hai. Yeh established pregnancy ko end nahi karta.

def.en: The finding that a person on HIV treatment whose viral load is undetectable does not pass HIV on through sex.
def.hg: Yeh finding ki HIV treatment le rahe jis insaan ka viral load undetectable hai, usse sex ke through HIV nahi phailta.
